title: Dispute History and the Portal Credit-Card Percentage for Placed Consumer Accounts
content:
Compliance manual note for **Placed Consumer Accounts** on the portal credit-card dispute percentage, which reflects recent disputes and verification mailings on the account's case history.

## Rule

The portal credit-card dispute percentage is:
- **90%** where one or more disputes with reason "insurance should have paid" or "amount incorrect" were received in the last six months and one or more verifications were mailed on the account in the last six months;
- **95%** where no dispute with either of those reasons but one or more disputes with another reason were received in the last six months and one or more verifications were mailed in the last six months;
- **100%** in every other case.

The portal credit-card limit is multiplied by the dispute percentage; the percentage applies to that limit and to no amount subtracted from it or added to it.

## What is read

- **Disputes**: dispute records on the account's case history, each with its reason (not my debt, amount incorrect, already paid, identity theft, insurance should have paid, or other reason) and its date received.
- **Verifications**: verification mailings on the account's case history, by mailing date. Any verification mailed on the account in the period counts, whichever dispute or request it answered.
- **Last six months**: fewer than six whole calendar months between the record's date and the handling date, a whole month being reached on the same day of a later month.

## Truth table

| Billing-reason dispute (insurance should have paid, amount incorrect) in the last six months | Dispute with another reason in the last six months | Verification mailed in the last six months | Percentage |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | either | Yes | 90% |
| No | Yes | Yes | 95% |
| No | No | either | 100% |
| Yes or no | either | No | 100% |

## Hypothetical cases

*Invented case histories, handling date 2026-10-10.*

- An "amount incorrect" dispute on 2026-06-01 and a verification mailed on 2026-06-20: 90%.
- A "not my debt" dispute on 2026-07-14 answered by a verification on 2026-07-30: 95%.
- An "insurance should have paid" dispute on 2026-08-05 still awaiting verification, and no other verification in the six months: 100%.
- A "not my debt" dispute on 2026-04-10 (six whole months back) and its verification on 2026-05-02: no dispute falls in the period, so 100%.
